nodes.name: network_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Network manager for aggregating and querying cache entries from public and private resource threads, and clearing cached resources.

nodes.name: CacheEntry
nodes.summary: A single cache resource entry identified by a key string.

nodes.name: NetworkManager
nodes.summary: Manages network cache by aggregating entries from public and private resource threads and providing cache query and clear operations.

nodes.name: cache_entries
nodes.summary: Retrieves the deduplicated list of cache entry keys from both public and private resource threads.

nodes.name: proxies.rs
nodes.summary: ConstellationProxy providing a thread-safe, disconnect-aware channel for sending messages from the embedder to the constellation process.

nodes.name: ConstellationProxy
nodes.summary: Thread-safe proxy wrapping a crossbeam channel sender with atomic disconnect detection for reliable message delivery to the constellation.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new ConstellationProxy with an unbounded crossbeam channel and initializes the disconnect flag.

nodes.name: try_send
nodes.summary: Attempts to send a message, returning an error if the channel is disconnected, and atomically marks the proxy as disconnected on failure.

nodes.name: responders.rs
nodes.summary: IPC responder infrastructure providing typed sender abstractions (IpcResponder, OneshotSender, ServoErrorChannel) for sending responses with default-fallback and error handling across process boundaries.

nodes.name: ServoErrorChannel
nodes.summary: An unbounded error channel providing a sender and try_receive for ServoError messages, with creation via Default.

nodes.name: IpcResponder
nodes.summary: Responder that sends a canned default response on drop if no explicit response was sent, preventing hangs from forgotten responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the drop-guard pattern typical in Rust for ensuring resource cleanup.

nodes.name: new_same_process
nodes.summary: Creates a new IpcResponder for same-process communication using a Tokio oneshot channel, with a default response sent on drop.

nodes.name: drop
nodes.summary: Drop handler that sends the default response if the responder was dropped without an explicit response being sent.

nodes.name: servo.rs
nodes.summary: Core Servo engine implementation providing the main embedder API: initialization, event loop, message handling (embedder, net, constellation), webview lifecycle, logging, memory reporting, content process management, and builder pattern configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses crossbeam channels and Select for multiplexed message dispatch across three separate receiver channels.

nodes.name: ServoInner
nodes.summary: Internal Servo engine state containing the message receivers, paint instance, constellation proxy, network manager, site data manager, JavaScript evaluator, webview map, error channel, pending input events, and shutdown state.

nodes.name: Servo
nodes.summary: Public Servo engine handle wrapping ServoInner in Rc<RefCell<>>, providing the embedder-facing API for initialization, navigation, event processing, logging, preferences, and content process management.

nodes.name: ServoBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for constructing a Servo instance with configurable options, preferences, event loop waker, protocol registry, and WebXR registry.

nodes.name: DefaultEventLoopWaker
nodes.summary: Default no-op event loop waker used when no custom waker is provided.

nodes.name: EmbedderMessageSelector
nodes.summary: Multiplexed receiver selector using crossbeam Select to poll from three channels (embedder, net, constellation) with a single try_recv_one_message operation.

nodes.name: BothLogger
nodes.summary: Logger implementation that delegates to both an env_logger and a custom embedder logger.

nodes.name: spin_event_loop
nodes.summary: Main event loop that polls paint messages and embedder/net/constellation channels, dispatches handled input events, performs paint updates, and sends frame-ready notifications.

nodes.name: handle_net_embedder_message
nodes.summary: Dispatches network-layer embedder messages including file picker requests, web resource loading, authentication requests, and cookie operations.

nodes.name: handle_embedder_message
nodes.summary: Dispatches main embedder messages including status/text/favicon updates, cursor changes, navigation controls, clipboard operations, devtools, gamepad haptics, notifications, screen metrics, and accessibility updates.

nodes.name: handle_constellation_embedder_message
nodes.summary: Dispatches constellation embedder messages including shutdown, navigation requests, webview creation/closure, focus changes, JavaScript evaluation results, input event handling, history updates, crash notifications, and media session events.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a full Servo instance including option/preference initialization, media platform setup, paint channel, constellation proxy, embedder/net/constellation channels, profiling, devtools, resource threads, storage threads, and the constellation itself.

nodes.name: create_constellation
nodes.summary: Creates and starts the constellation process with all required factories, threads (Bluetooth, font service), and registries (WebXR, WebGL, WebGPU).

nodes.name: run_content_process
nodes.summary: Runs a content (sandboxed) process with its own event loop: initializes options, prefs, sandboxing, script thread, fetch thread, logging, memory reporting, and hangs monitor.

nodes.name: create_paint_channel
nodes.summary: Creates the paint infrastructure with an event-loop-backed paint thread, waker, and cross-process paint API for rendering.

nodes.name: setup_logging
nodes.summary: Initializes dual logging (env_logger + custom embedder logger) and sets the global log level.

nodes.name: register_system_memory_reporter_for_event_loop
nodes.summary: Registers a system memory reporter callback that collects memory reports and sends them to the profiler channel.

nodes.name: servo_delegate.rs
nodes.summary: ServoDelegate trait defining the embedder callback interface for error notification, devtools server events, devtools connections, web resource loading, and notification display.

nodes.name: ServoDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait defining the top-level embedder callbacks for error notification, devtools lifecycle, resource loading, notifications, and console messages.
